How it works

  1. 01

    Connect ad accounts

    Link Meta ad accounts and, if needed, Google Ads via MCC for the client workspace.

  2. 02

    Review performance

    Check spend, CTR and fatigue signals. Open suggestions when the desk flags something worth changing.

  3. 03

    Approve before acting

    Accept, edit or reject suggestions. Creative helper drafts stay drafts until a human decides next steps in Ads Manager or your process.

FAQ

Can Podo Social change my Google Ads?+

No. Google Ads is read-only (spend, campaigns, ad groups, ads via MCC). Use it for visibility and reports.

Do ad suggestions apply automatically?+

No. Meta-side suggestions wait for approval. Nothing goes live without your team.

What does the creative helper do?+

It drafts copy and angles for review only. It does not publish ads by itself.

Ready to run client social from one desk?

Create a workspace in a minute. Connect channels, invite your team, and keep every approval in one queue.
